lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; same point as the earlier rulings on this line. i1040gi p. 98, Line 21, among the conditions for the deduction: "You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's" 2025 tax return. The reply gives worksheet line 9 on every return not married filing separately and has no test that the filer or the spouse is claimed as a dependent (its note says it found no input that asks it; the project reads person.sav_claimed). On completed returns where a person on the return is claimed the project enters zero and the reply the worksheet amount: 4 completed value differences, the recorded witnesses mutation.t2.sli.qss_divisor ($2,045.00 against $0.00; person[taxpayer].sav_claimed yes), stage11.sli.claimed, stage11.sli.spouse_claimed and stage16.sd.line17_no_skips_19. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/sli.json`, pass e9feb0fa0109; 1,767 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026): 1,844 of 1,893 in-scope comparisons agree; differences by kind {"candidate-refuses": 381, "candidate-unknown": 36, "project-unknown": 8, "value": 5}; the candidate refusals are on its sa.excluded_income declaration and on refusals reaching the line from other forms, the fifth value difference is on a refused record. The project line is retained.
